what: Loading-screen time from "Raising the Stronghold" (96%) to done, returning visit
method: Local Vite dev build, headless Chromium (SwiftShader), 412x880 mobile viewport, CPU profiler on; 5 alternating pairs of base (199d1e5 tree) and fix (a5d3723). Absolute numbers are inflated by software rendering; compare pairs.
liveDeviceTracelogs: 5 sustained_low_fps reports from the reporter phone (Android 10, DPR 3.25) start 3.7-5.7 s after navigation with 100-400 ms main-thread tasks, bottleneck encounters-render (the 3D hero), the loop that used to run behind the loading screen.
